entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NativeAOT for Android and iOS is using the wrong ILC and runtime pack #56479

Closed

  • Workload restore - support solution filters #36277

    Test Debt
  • Normalize package pseudo-locale satellite casing consistently #56485

  • [release/11.0.2xx] Add incremental container archive publishing #56483
    Area-Containers

  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56473

    Area-ReadyToRun, Area-WasmSdk, 12.0-preview1
